title: José G NDE 8809
content: My father and I were in his room when I went into the bathroom. My blood sugar began to drop. I experienced a heavy dizziness. I was moving at full velocity, like free falling into an endlessly spiraling tunnel. In that fall, all my life's memories began to appear in photos. I saw them one after the other and appearing from the left to right. The photos came along with a very strong 'blowing' sound every time it passed me. Later I exited the tunnel and was lying on the bathroom floor beside my father. He told me that I had fainted. One year later, I fainted again. During that time, I experienced something that made me feel as if I were in another dimension. I fainted at a bar although I hadn't drank more than one beer. I was talking with a friend. All of a sudden, everything began to get dark and I told my friend I was about to faint. Then, I began to walk in a city of darkness that was illuminated by weak lights. I floated inside a sphere that was full of rays of energy. There were people who passed by around me. they had shadows covering their faces. It seemed that they could not see me. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 2015 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. I fainted. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I'm not sure. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I think probably never. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. I was in a Tunnel. Everything happened fast. In the energy sphere, everything happened in real time. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The sounds were much stronger. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes The first faint was a free-fall down a tunnel formed of spirals which was seemingly endless. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain I don't remember much. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place In both faints; 1. The tunnel was unknown and supernatural. 2. The sphere of energy was mystical and also supernatural. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Tranquility. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control In my first faint I remember seeing images of all my life's memories. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists In the second faint, the sphere of energy, I knew I wasn't in our perceived physical dimension, but another unknown one. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Unknown Lucid dreams, leaving the body, and seeing things before they happened in dreams. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I don't know. My father always told me he had gifts and that I had them. There has been many events in my dreams that unfold in the future just as how I dreamed them. In my lucid dreams I have seen the dead, I run from this and do not feel in peace. I always experience fear when these dreams occur. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Absolutely. The tunnel experience was incredible. After that, I have always thought when one dies it is a grand voyage to what I describe as, the unknown Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Immediately with my father, and he understood. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes My father had a close call with death in a heart attack, he went deep 'further' to the indescribable light where he saw his mother and held his hand out, she only said goodbye and then he returned. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He described 'moving at full velocity, like free falling into an endlessly spiraling tunnel' with a strong 'blowing' sound as memory-photos passed.

environment.environment_other_detail: Second faint: a 'city of darkness' illuminated by weak lights; he 'floated inside a sphere' full of 'rays of energy.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fainting episodes; first associated with blood sugar dropping; second occurred at a bar after one beer.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Second faint included walking in a dark city and floating in an energy sphere among people with shadowed faces.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two separate fainting events: (1) tunnel with sequential photo-like life memories, then awakening on bathroom floor; (2) darkness/city and energy sphere with other people present.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: He fainted twice; tunnel described in the first faint; unearthly realm described in the second.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life memories appeared as photos moving left-to-right during the tunnel, each accompanied by a strong 'blowing' sound. Second event: floating inside a sphere full of rays of energy while people with shadow-covered faces passed by and seemed unable to see him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "moving at full velocity, like free falling into an endlessly spiraling tunnel"; "all my life's memories began to appear in photos"; "a very strong 'blowing' sound"; "walk in a city of darkness that was illuminated by weak lights"; "floated inside a sphere that was full of rays of energy"; "After that, I have always thought when one dies it is a grand voyage to what I describe as, the unknown"
